MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The SanDisk cards fit my repeated purchases of SD and microSD cards for my devices and photography equipment; I would consider the extra capacity after checking compatibility.",
    "The USB extension cables could help me connect my existing card reader more conveniently, making them a practical addition to accessories I already use."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Buying memory cards does not mean I need a 16TB external drive, an internal desktop drive, or an SSD enclosure; those require storage needs or projects I do not currently have.",
    "My photography accessories do not indicate a need for surveillance cameras, and my power strips do not imply interest in Alexa-controlled outlets.",
    "Owning a television and other electronics does not make streaming equipment or wireless earbuds a current priority."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My memory-card purchases seem to have been interpreted as interest in storage equipment generally, although the device and purpose matter to me.",
    "My purchases of practical electronics accessories seem to have been stretched into interest in unrelated electronic devices and home automation."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I repeatedly buy accessories that support equipment I already use, so a clear connection to that equipment matters more than a broad electronics connection.",
    "My past cards were 2GB to 32GB, so larger cards are only useful if my devices support their capacity and format; higher capacity and speed alone do not establish a fit."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in memory cards and useful connections but stretched it too far into unrelated storage projects and new device needs."
}
